name: break_down_traffic
title: Break traffic down by a dimension
description: Localizes a problem. Splits traffic along one dimension, in the window and in its baseline, so that a value that vanished and one that appeared are both visible. Typical sequence on an affected API: by=status (which status codes), by=application (which consumers; application "Unknown (credential not resolved)" is traffic the gateway rejected before it could identify the consumer), by=consumer_ip, by=path, by=gateway. Without api, by=api lists the busiest APIs and by=gateway tells whether one gateway is off. Returns the ten busiest values of the dimension.

api.description: Id or exact name of an API. Use the id when several APIs share a name. Omit to look at the whole environment.

statusGroup.description: Keep only requests answered with this status class.

window.description: Length of the time range to look at, ending at `until`: a number followed by m, h or d, for example 15m, 2h or 1d. Default 15m. Never an epoch value.

until.description: End of the time range as an ISO-8601 UTC instant, for example 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z. Default: now. Set it to look at a past incident.

key.description: The value: an id, a status code, a path, an IP.

presence.description: APPEARED: traffic in the window only. VANISHED: traffic in the baseline only.

responseTimeP95Ms.description: 95th percentile of the time to answer the consumer, backend included, in milliseconds. Absent without traffic.

endpointResponseTimeP95Ms.description: 95th percentile of the time spent waiting for the backend, in milliseconds. Close to responseTimeP95Ms when the backend is the slow part; far below it when the gateway is.
